purpose: Explore nested intake → worker → independent review using JSON records and explicit rules before building functionality.
authority: This specimen is not the queue, role registry, permissions source or executable worker protocol. Existing authorities remain authoritative. Synthetic approval only controls hypothetical transitions.

identity_rules.component_ids: Definitions identified once; instances refer to definitions. IDs here are specimen-local, not new canonical library IDs.
identity_rules.instance_ids: Unique per virtual model; shared SFUs use references rather than copied definitions.
identity_rules.containment: Responsibility and ownership, not scheduling. No containment cycles.
identity_rules.dataflow: Named output-to-input edges; no implicit field mapping.
identity_rules.versions: Model version is distinct from referenced schema, contract, source and future seed versions.

rules.output: No admitted task or draft; retain diagnostic.

rules.condition: Task present but fails the pinned existing worker-task schema.
rules.output: No admitted task or draft; retain schema error path.

rules.condition: Task valid but simulated authorization is denied or unknown.
rules.output: No worker delegation, draft or external effects.

rules.condition: Task valid and simulated authorization is allowed.
rules.output: Bind unchanged task on e1 and e3; delegate worker input to prepare SFU.

rules.condition: Synthetic draft fixture is supplied and its actual bytes match the artifact reference.
rules.output: Bubble prepare output through worker boundary on e2. Missing/mismatched fixture blocks with no draft.

rules.condition: Different simulated author/reviewer actors, pinned task match and synthetic review criteria satisfied.
rules.output: Assistant-simulated verdict only; no component_verified, integrated or live claims. Failed review blocks and preserves diagnostics.

invariants: Never bypass earlier rejection/denial with later rules.
Missing, invalid or denied input produces no draft and no success verdict.
No external effects in any scenario.
Reviewer actor differs from author actor; role names alone do not prove actual independence.
Every simulated trace names its rule and evidence class.
Existing task-schema validity proves shape only, not ownership, live issue state, permissions or completed work.
Artifact hash proves fixture bytes, not an executed worker.

seed_options.reason: Reference existing Copier owner; no generator or legacy import in this specimen.

review_criteria: C1 task identity is preserved across the three children.
C2 draft reference resolves to the labelled synthetic fixture bytes.
C3 author and reviewer actors differ in scenario metadata.
C4 simulated verdict makes no real execution or integration claim.
known_gaps: The top-level model/scenario/trace shapes are provisional and not a new shared schema family.
No domain algorithms, real worker launch, external effects, scheduling, retry/concurrency semantics or performance tests.
No actual component call/result exchange is claimed; this design maps the existing task and artifact definitions only.

Four fixtures do not prove general correctness or exhaust the rule space. R5 missing/mismatched draft and R6 failed-review branches are specified in prose only; explicit transition/fixture coverage is deferred.
Actual independent review is separate from the simulated reviewer actor.
validation_recipe: Parse all JSON strictly, rejecting duplicate keys and nonfinite values.
Check unique IDs, existing parents, acyclic containment and matching named ports/contracts.
Verify source references against pinned repository bytes and resolve JSON Pointer fragments locally.
Validate nonmissing scenario task payloads with the existing worker-task schema and explicit date-time checker; invalid fixture must fail.
Validate draft references with component-blackbox artifact_ref and local review verdicts with the provisional review schema.
Compare traces against fixture expectations; this is consistency checking, not execution of the modeled worker.
Run existing focused black-box and component-conformance regressions unchanged.
